items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: Now, I was the youngest in the group, and my brother Ulyss, and my brother Emile, and my sister was a leader, you know.

ctx.x: That's my first encounter with music, you know. Now, I was the youngest in the group, and my brother Ulyss, and my brother Emile, and my sister was a leader, you know. I had another sister younger than me, and another brother, too, and you know, but they wasn't born, you know. Right. Right. And they were, you know, after me, it was almost a baby, and then something. But anyway, we used to, used to have a, some man had a quartet named the Robinson Hummin' Four, you know.
Robinson Hummin' Four, sure. Robinson Hummin' Four. Robinson Hummin' Four.
